clean.description: Removes the outputs the named targets of the project declare, keeping any the workspace tracks as source, and runs the tool's own clean commands when given

publish.description: Delivers the files a project's packaging targets wrote to its registry or store through its tool's own publish command; runs through nx release publish

attach.description: Uploads the files a project's packaging targets wrote to the GitHub release whose tag nx release gives the version its manifest states, through gh release upload --clobber
